AnalyticsDaily.title: AnalyticsDaily
AnalyticsDaily.description: Daily anonymous aggregate telemetry counters for JNB Align (GDPR-compliant, zero PII).

dateKey.description: UTC date key in YYYY-MM-DD format matching document ID.

visits.description: Number of page visits on this date.

analyses.description: Number of ATS CV analyses launched on this date.

urls.description: Number of job offers extracted by URL on this date.

downloads.description: Number of PDF or Word document downloads on this date.

copies.description: Number of raw text copies on this date.

uploads.description: Number of CV or job offer documents attached on this date.

mobileEvents.description: Count of actions from mobile devices on this date.

desktopEvents.description: Count of actions from desktop devices on this date.

langFr.description: Count of actions in French mode on this date.

langEn.description: Count of actions in International English mode on this date.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last recorded counter update.

AnalyticsVisitor.title: AnalyticsVisitor
AnalyticsVisitor.description: Anonymous non-PII browser identifier record for persistent unique visitor counting.

visitorId.description: Random client-generated non-PII identifier matching document ID.

firstDateKey.description: UTC date key of first seen visit.

isMobile.description: Whether the initial visit was on a mobile viewport.

AnalyticsConfig.title: AnalyticsConfig
AnalyticsConfig.description: Publicly readable non-PII runtime analytics configuration (Google Analytics 4 measurement ID).

ga4MeasurementId.description: Optional GA4 Measurement ID (format G-XXXXXXXXXX) or empty string.

ga4Enabled.description: Whether GA4 script loading and event forwarding are enabled.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last admin update.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authoritative RBAC document granting Admin dashboard read/config privileges.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

/analytics_daily/{dateId}.description: Daily anonymous aggregate action counters (visits, analyses, urls, downloads, copies, uploads). Atomic +1 public increment, Admin-only reads.

/analytics_visitors/{visitorId}.description: Anonymous unique browser IDs (create-only public, Admin-only reads).

/app_config/{configId}.description: Single public config document ('analytics') storing optional GA4 Measurement ID. Admin-only writes.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Administrator registry managed solely by the bootstrapped project owner.
